tooltip.geist_hellblazer.trench_coat: Shirt open at the collar, the tie pulled loose. Smells of rain and cigarettes.
tooltip.geist_hellblazer.black_trousers: Black wool. Has seen worse nights than this one.
message.geist_hellblazer.welcome: The occult section has opened a casebook in your name. Press %s to read it.
case.geist_hellblazer.objective.haunting: Lay %1$s of the risen to rest at the marked place, after dark
case.geist_hellblazer.brief.hunt.0: %3$s. The %2$s kind have been turning up where they've no business being - by the churchyard wall, at the well, in the lane after the lamps go out. We want %1$s of them put down. Don't ask what they were before. It doesn't help.
case.geist_hellblazer.brief.hunt.1: Something is calling them up out of the dark - %2$s, by the look of it - and they're answering. Thin the choir: %1$s of them. When it's done the calling will stop for a while. It always does, for a while.
case.geist_hellblazer.brief.hunt.2: Folk have stopped walking home at night. That's how we know. %1$s of them, %3$s - %2$s, the lot - and if one of them says your name, keep swinging.
case.geist_hellblazer.brief.target.0: This one has a name: %4$s. It goes about in the shape of the %2$s, keeping company it shouldn't, out past the edge of the maps. It won't be alone, and it'll be harder to kill than it looks - they always are, once they've been named. Put it down, %3$s.
case.geist_hellblazer.brief.target.1: %4$s was seen at the marked place three nights running, with others stood round it like a congregation. Our people won't go near. You will. It's wearing a borrowed shape (%2$s) - don't trust the shape.
case.geist_hellblazer.brief.target.2: We've a file on %4$s going back further than any of us. Every time it's put down it comes back with a new face. This time it wears the %2$s. Make it count, %3$s - and don't take anything it offers you.
case.geist_hellblazer.brief.haunting.0: There's a place where the dead won't stay down. Go there after dark and stand in it. They'll come up out of the ground around you. Put %1$s of them back where they belong and the place will rest.
case.geist_hellblazer.brief.haunting.1: The ground's gone wrong at the marked place - soul-fire in the grass, a chill that follows you about. In daylight it's only a field. After sundown it's a door. Close it: %1$s of the risen, %3$s.
case.geist_hellblazer.brief.haunting.2: Old burial ground, no stones left to say so. Something's woken it. Wait for the dark, walk into the ring, and keep putting them back until they stop coming. %1$s should do it.
case.geist_hellblazer.brief.relic.0: We need %1$s of these off the street: %2$s. In the wrong hands it's more than it looks. Bring it in - send it from the casebook once you've got it on you.
case.geist_hellblazer.brief.relic.1: Someone has been buying up %2$s - %1$s, by our count - and we'd rather it ended up in our vault than in whatever circle is being chalked out. Find it. Send it in.
case.geist_hellblazer.brief.relic.2: Don't ask what %2$s is for. The answer will keep you up. Just gather %1$s, keep it wrapped, and send it in through the casebook, %3$s.
Our maps have a blank where %2$s should be. Everyone we send comes back with nothing to say, or doesn't come back. Go and stand in it. That's all. Being there is the job.
Something is listening from %2$s. We want someone to walk in and be heard walking in. You'll know you're there when the casebook does.
Old reports put a door somewhere in %2$s. We don't need you to open it, %3$s. We need to know it's still shut. Set foot there and the file closes.
structure.geist_hellblazer.swamp_hut: a witch's hut in the swamp
case.geist_hellblazer.deny.full: You're working as many files as you can carry. Close one, or walk away from one.
case.geist_hellblazer.deny.levels: New leads cost %1$s levels of experience.
case.geist_hellblazer.deny.end: Not out here. Take that one where there's ground to stand on.
case.geist_hellblazer.promo.title: PROMOTED
case.geist_hellblazer.rank.nobody.opens: Hunts, hauntings, relics and places no one should go. Three files on the board, two worked at a time.
case.geist_hellblazer.rank.consultant.op: Named figures start turning up. Strays, husks and pillagers; pyramids, outposts and old ruins.
Endermen, wither skeletons and blazes. Strongholds and nether fortresses.
case.geist_hellblazer.rank.exorcist.open: A fourth file on the board. Ghasts, wither skulls, bastions and witch covens.
case.geist_hellblazer.rank.hexbreaker.op: A third file worked at once. Evokers and vexes; the deep dark, mansions and ancient cities.
Dragon's breath. Every file pays better than it did.
case.geist_hellblazer.rank.hellblazer.op: The top of the ladder. The section has nothing left to teach you.

casebook.geist_hellblazer.head: GEIST // OCCULT SECTION
casebook.geist_hellblazer.cases.loading: The files are still coming in...
casebook.geist_hellblazer.cases.none_act: Nothing being worked. Pick a file from the board and take it.
casebook.geist_hellblazer.cases.subject: SUBJECT
casebook.geist_hellblazer.record.rate: %s%% of the files you took, you closed
casebook.geist_hellblazer.how.hunt: Put down the number asked, anywhere. Only the kind named counts.
casebook.geist_hellblazer.how.target: Go to the marked place - the casebook and the HUD point the way. The named one waits there with company, three times as hard to kill.
casebook.geist_hellblazer.how.haunting: Go to the marked place and wait for dark. Stand inside the ring of soul-fire and the dead come up round you. Put enough of them back.
casebook.geist_hellblazer.how.relic: Gather what's asked for, carry it, and press SEND IN on the file.
casebook.geist_hellblazer.how.investigat: Set foot in the place named. The file closes the moment you're there.
